_comment: Model catalog for the shipped packs: filename -> where to get it. Entries with a 'source' URL were verified against the hosting site's API (URL, exact size, license) and are auto-downloadable when COMFY_MODELS_DIR is configured. Entries with source 'community' are community-published files we won't link: search the named hubs for the exact filename and place it yourself. A catalog.json in DATA_DIR/workflows/ merges over this one (same filename wins).

krea2_raw_fp8_scaled.safetensors.notes: Krea 2 base model, fp8-scaled ComfyUI repackage by Comfy-Org.

qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors.notes: Qwen3-VL 4B text encoder used by Krea 2, fp8-scaled.

minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_nvfp4.safetensor.notes: NVFP4 quantization of the pruned MiniMax H3 video model. This exact file lives in community NVFP4 repos (several byte-identical mirrors exist), NOT in the official Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 repo, which ships bf16 / fp8_scaled / int8_convrot variants under different filenames. Prefer a quantized build like this one: an unquantized ~26GB+ bf16 UNET offloads heavily on a 24 GB card.

qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safeten.notes: Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder for MiniMax H3, NVFP4/AWQ quantized, Comfy-Org repackage.

minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors.notes: MiniMax H3 video VAE (fp16), Comfy-Org repackage.

minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors.notes: MiniMax H3 audio VAE (fp32), Comfy-Org repackage.

(Krea 2) 8-Step Turbo Distill Rank 64 V2.license: inherits the Krea 2 Community License (per the model page)
(Krea 2) 8-Step Turbo Distill Rank 64 V2.notes: "Krea-2 Turbo 8-Step Distillation LoRA (SVD Extract)" on Civitai, version V2026.1 (~469 MB; Civitai reports 458,312.62 KB). Civitai downloads need a (free) logged-in account, so no direct URL — download from the model page and keep the filename exactly as-is, parentheses and spaces included.

krea2filterbypass3.safetensors.notes: Community Krea 2 LoRA with no canonical home; search model hubs for the exact filename. Beware 160-byte placeholder reuploads that carry this name — a real LoRA is megabytes, not bytes.

Krea2-realism-V2.safetensors.notes: Community realism LoRA; reuploads exist on Hugging Face under this exact filename. Search the hubs and check the file size before trusting a copy.

Detailer-KREA2.safetensors.notes: Community detail-enhancer LoRA for Krea 2; no canonical home found. Search model hubs for the exact filename.

bloomgirls-ultrarealism-krea2_4k.safeten.notes: Community LoRA originally published on Tensor.Art as "[KR2]BloomGirls UltraRealism"; find it there or search hubs for the exact filename.

lenovo_krea2.safetensors.notes: Krea 2 build of the "Lenovo Ultrareal" LoRA published on Civitai; search there for the exact filename.

RealisticSnapshotKrea2.safetensors.notes: Krea 2 build of the "Realistic Snapshot" LoRA family published on Civitai; search there for the exact filename.

realism_engine_krea2_v3.1.safetensors.notes: Community "realism engine" LoRA; reuploads exist on Hugging Face under this exact filename. Check the file size before trusting a copy.
